messages.subject: Re: data.frame error: cannot open file 'Rplots.pdf'
parts:
I do not see the obvious problem here (perhaps you can further
simplify your example). The error about Rplots.pdf is often caused by
a plot that was not captured by your graphics device (in this case,
png()), so R tried to save it using the default pdf() device, which
writes the plot to Rplots.pdf in the current working directory, and
your app does not have write permission in the current working
directory.

BTW, I do not understand what the code below means:

png(outfile, width=600, height=425, pointsize = 10)
cplot <- function(A,B,C,D, plot=TRUE)
dev.off()

It seems you defined a function cplot() but did not really close the
png() device. It is equivalent to

png(outfile, width=600, height=425, pointsize = 10)
cplot <- function(A,B,C,D, plot=TRUE) {
dev.off()
}

I'd recommend you to leave out the code related to renderTable() and
see if the error is still there.

Regards,
Yihui
